task: Cover account deletion on the account page (`/`). Delete account opens a confirmation dialog whose Delete my account button stays disabled until the box contains exactly `DELETE` (lower-case or partial text does not count). Escape, like Cancel, closes the dialog without deleting and moves focus back to the Delete account button. Confirming deletes the account on the server and shows `Your account has been deleted` in place of the profile; after a reload the page still shows the account as deleted.
